name: lens-dev-plugin
description: Unity MCP Lens development workflow bundle for Codex. Plugin v0.1.7, aligned with Lens host 0.1.0-alpha.24+.

interface.shortDescription: v0.1.7 Unity MCP Lens workflows with fast health, static_all, stable tool facades, recovery diagnostics, and bridge access.
interface.longDescription: Lens Dev Plugin v0.1.7 bundles Unity MCP Bridge, Unity Dev Assistant, Unity MCP Lens Development, and the local Lens MCP server config for Codex. This plugin version teaches Codex to use Unity.Editor.HealthCheckFast first, static_all by default, Unity.Tools.List/Invoke/BatchInvoke as client-surface fallback facades, paused Unity.PlayMode.StepVerifier for play-mode smoke checks, Unity.Workflow.SelectPackThroughMainMenu for FallingSands Main Menu pack selection, diagnose-only Unity.Editor.RecoverFromHang, FallingSands GPU probes, and status-file hygiene from Lens host 0.1.0-alpha.24+.
defaultPrompt: Check the Unity MCP Lens bridge.
Start a Unity dev session with Lens.
